move: ring bursts, letters rise through masks, bar wipes across, lift out
how: On a Behance-blue stage a thin ring scales in from 0.2/opacity:0 (expo.out) over the first 40% then expands to 1.6 and fades (power2.out) from 30%. The 240px 'B' and 190px 'e' rise from yPercent:110 through overflow-hidden rows with expo.out at 3% and 7%; a white rounded bar above the e wipes in scaleX from the left (expo.out) at 23%; the whole mark settles from scale 0.96 with elastic.out(1,0.5) at 33% while a caption rises through its own mask (yPercent:120, expo.out) at 32%. Exit from 78%: caption shoots up, bar collapses, letters lift out yPercent:-110 with power3.in staggered 0.07.
adapt: Change the two letters, sizes, the caption, stage colour (#1769ff) and bar position; keep the staggered expo.out rise, the elastic settle and the ring burst.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the ring, masked letter rows, bar and caption in el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with entrances 0-0.4 of D and exit from 0.78. No plugins; scope selectors to el.
caveats: overflow:hidden rows with fixed heights act as masks, must match the font sizes
stylised 'Be' in Sharp Grotesk with a bar, an approximation of the Behance mark
